metadata.purpose: Repeat six-pair M25 module-isolated AVX2 radix-11 ido=1 comparison against M24 to check control stability across the full 34-cell SHT matrix.
metadata.candidate_source_base: M24 source commit 9a85e38, plus the M25 source patch identified by SHA-256
metadata.workload: All current exact C2C and real SHT target operation/length cells; scalar and spin-1 row batches; one transform thread
metadata.timing: Six alternating process pairs; seven warmed samples per operation
metadata.compiler: Rust 1.99.0 stable; optimized bench profile; portable x86_64 target; runtime SIMD dispatch
metadata.cpu_model: AMD Ryzen 9 5950X; process pinned to logical CPU 30
metadata.pre_capture_host_condition: No SHT or FFT benchmark process observed at 2026-10-16T07:17:18Z. One-minute load average was 0.65; five-minute load average was 1.44 after the prior SHT run had ended.
metadata.dispatch_note: The candidate applies an AVX2 f64 radix-11 kernel to ido=1 passes with l1>=2, vectorizing pairs of outer groups. Odd outer tails and unsafe inverse inputs use the scalar path. f32 and CPUs without AVX2 retain the general scalar pass.
metadata.runner: ../m24-radix103/run_m24_clean_capture.py records process IDs, uptime, and load averages before, during, and after each run, and fsyncs every JSONL record.
metadata.code_layout_note: The ido=1 helper is an out-of-line cold function in src/complex/radix11_ido1.rs. It appears after the main complex FFT code in the linked executable. The N=682 execute_first_pass_in_place symbol shifts by 0x210 bytes from M24, compared with a 0xb00 shift when the helper was in complex.rs.

a.label: RustSHT-FFT M25 radix-11 ido=1 AVX2 module-isolated candidate
